|notes=The Players Committee released the original-layout slip for Take Evasive Action on 30 May 2003. The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Take Evasive Action (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Take Evasive Action (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. Both editions retain the three Used targets, the Walker Garrison exception and immunity to Sense. The Lost mode cancels and redraws a just-drawn opposing lightsaber combat or weapon destiny.
